The Hunt

At the end of each round, an expedition sets off to kill the Creature. This expedition is led by the player or players who have collected the most Hunt tokens. The Storybook will prompt you to compare totals. All tied players go on the expedition together. You may secretly look at your Hunt tokens when you collect them.

The player or players leading the expedition reveal their tokens and count up the total number of Clues on the reverse side. If you have collected a number of Clues equal to or greater than the expedition amount needed, the expedition succeeds and the Creature is killed.

All players on a successful expedition receive 5VP.

If unsuccessful, another expedition will begin at the end of the next round.
